reviews.title: Well Priced, Good Quality
reviews.comment: Affordable, usb provides easy connectivity, sound quality is great for my needs (zoom calls), plug and play, low noise.
reviews.author: Lawboss

reviews.title: Amazing Quality as expected from AT
reviews.comment: High quality and crisp voice recording. Looks amazing and the big mute button is very handy and helpful in many conditions.
reviews.author: Prime

reviews.title: Great dynamic USB-C mic
reviews.comment: This is a great dynamic mic.  Doesn't get all the background noise out, but better than my other mics.  Audio Technica mics all sound great.  Everyone on my Meet calls say this sounds great.
reviews.author: David Kieras

reviews.title: Best USB mic I've owned
reviews.comment: Everyone has said how much better this mic sounds compared to 150 dollar headsets. Though they've said there's no difference between this dedicated mic and the audeze Maxwell with its dedicated mic. I use a mix of different headphones plugged into a dac/amp when gaming with this microphone. Easy to adjust but the dac/another built in is horrible. There's no bass whatsoever and that takes the life out of any audio. Not enough bass to balance the treble. I use with a PlayStation 5.
reviews.author: Joseph Emerson

reviews.title: Pretty good
reviews.comment: It's a great all-purpose mic. Use it for podcasts, music recording, or whatever.
reviews.author: Alex
